ledger: child's hands | normal appearance | blurry and moving unnaturally fast | hand movements become excessively fast and blurry
balls in bowl | solid, distinct red, yellow, and green balls | a blurred, swishing mass of color | solid balls transform into a liquid-like blur

findings.description: When the child's hand begins to spin the balls, the balls lose their solid shapes and merge into a blurry, liquid-like state that defies physics.
